name: MEC Company Ltd.
summary: MEC Company Ltd., formed in 1969 with headquarters in Amagasaki, Japan, researches, develops, makes and distributes chemicals, equipment and materials for printed circuit board production in Asian and European markets. Its chemicals address steps such as adhesion enhancement, roughening treatments and resist stripping. A key offering is AMALPHA, a metal surface treatment technology that enables direct bonding between metals and resins.
